source: Checklists and requirements adapted from the MIT-licensed ml-paper-writing guide (Orchestra Research) and the official venue pages; verify against the current call for papers.

universal.text: All claims in the abstract and introduction are supported by evidence (claim-evidence map has no open row)
References complete and verified; all citations resolve
A Limitations section exists and states honest scope
Every figure and table has a self-contained caption
Error bars, confidence intervals, or tests are reported, with the number of runs and how the uncertainty is computed
Hyperparameters and their selection are documented
Compute resources are stated (hardware, time per run, total)
Licenses of used and released assets are stated
Ethics and broader-impact considerations are addressed (or a one-sentence justification)
Human-subjects approval or exemption and consent are documented
Baselines are appropriate, recent, and fairly tuned
The PDF compiles without errors and all figures render
Review version is anonymous (no names, acknowledgments, grant numbers, identifying links)
The correct template (venue and year) is used; margins and font sizes are untouched
Main content is within the page limit for the current call
Supplementary material is organised and self-consistent with the paper

acl.name: ACL family (ACL, EMNLP, NAACL, EACL, AACL, ARR)
acl.version: acl-style-files pinned commit; read the current call

pages.appendix: allowed, outside the limit, same anonymity rules

items.text: Limitations section present (mandatory; does not count toward the page limit)
Ethical considerations addressed when relevant
Responsible NLP: bias, fairness, dual-use, and privacy considered
If applicable: language diversity addressed, non-English languages included, translation quality verified
If applicable: annotator details, agreement metrics, and compensation documented
Disclosure of AI writing assistance follows the current policy
Responsible NLP checklist completed in the submission system (not in the PDF)

ieee.name: IEEE family (IEEEtran, ICASSP, Interspeech, SLT, ASRU, EUSIPCO, IJCNN)
ieee.version: IEEEtran from CTAN; ICASSP and Interspeech publish a kit every year

pages.content: typically 4 (+1 page for references only); verify the call
pages.appendix: normally not in the budget; use supplementary material or the project site

ieee.anonymity: follow the call (often single-blind; some tracks double-blind)

items.text: Index terms present (4 to 6, alphabetical)
Bibliography style is IEEEtran and citations are numeric
Listening-test scores carry 95% confidence intervals and listener demographics (ITU-T P.800 convention)
Abstract within about 150 to 220 words
Figures are vector or at least 1600 DPI raster; fonts embedded; PDF eXpress compliant
Funding sentence follows the lab format (MeitY wording when applicable)

neurips.name: NeurIPS
neurips.version: 2025 kit pinned; check the current year's style files page
required_sections: paper checklist (after references, outside the limit)

items.text: Claims alignment: abstract and introduction match theoretical and experimental results; contributions, assumptions, and limitations clearly stated
Limitations: dedicated section covering strong assumptions, robustness to violations, scope, and performance-influencing factors
Theory and proofs: full assumptions and complete proofs (main text or appendix, with a proof sketch in the main text)
Reproducibility: steps to verify results (code release, instructions, model access, or checkpoints)
Data and code access: instructions, exact commands, and environment (supplement or URLs)
Experimental details: data splits, hyperparameters, and how they were selected
Statistical significance: error bars, intervals, or tests, with the calculation method and assumptions
Compute resources: worker types (CPU/GPU), memory, storage, time per run, and total project compute
Code of Ethics: compliance confirmed, deviations noted
Broader impacts: negative applications, fairness, privacy, mitigation
Safeguards: controlled release and usage guidelines for high-risk models or scraped data
License respect: creators cited; license names, URLs, versions, and terms of service
Asset documentation: datasheet or model card for new releases (training data, limitations, consent, licensing)
Human subjects: instructions, compensation, and minimum-wage compliance for crowdsourcing
IRB approval or equivalent, with risks disclosed (anonymised at submission)
LLM declaration: disclose LLMs used as a core methodology component (writing and editing use needs no declaration)

icml.name: ICML
required_sections: Impact Statement (end of paper, before references, outside the limit)

items.text: Broader Impact / Impact Statement: positive impacts, negative impacts, mitigation, who may be affected
Data splits clearly specified
Hyperparameters listed, with search ranges and selection method
Compute resources specified
Code availability stated
Error bars on all figures; standard deviation versus standard error specified; number of runs stated
Significance tests if comparing methods
No identifiable repository URLs; prior work cited in the third person

iclr.name: ICLR
required_sections: LLM-use disclosure (separate appendix section, if LLMs played a significant role)

items.text: LLM disclosure: if LLMs played a significant role in ideation or writing (could be regarded as a contributor), describe the precise role in a separate appendix section; grammar checking and minor editing need none
Reproducibility statement (optional, recommended): supporting materials, code, data, checkpoints
Ethics statement (optional, up to one page, outside the limit)
Reciprocal reviewing: authors on 3 or more papers review at least 6; each submission has at least one author registered to review at least 3
No identifying repository URLs in the review version

aaai.name: AAAI
aaai.version: 2026 kit; use the unmodified author kit
aaai.citations: natbib; style sets aaai2026 bibliography style itself
required_sections: strict adherence to the style file

items.text: No forbidden packages or commands (hyperref, geometry, fullpage, balance, authblk, float, fontenc, \newpage, \clearpage, \pagestyle, \baselinestretch, \columnsep, \tiny, negative \vspace)
No \bibliographystyle command (the style file sets it; a second one is an error)
Anonymous-submission option is used for review and links do not reveal identity
Reproducibility and other checklists in the current author kit are completed

colm.name: COLM
colm.version: 2026 template (official repository pinned at a commit)
required_sections: Ethics Statement and Author Contributions as in the official sample

items.text: Ethics statement present (the official sample includes one)
The paper is framed around language models and their evaluation or use
Review version is anonymous (submission option, no identifying links)
